content: स्नुह्, स्नुहा, -हिः {%f.%} -ही ¦ The milk-hedge plant. [Raghunandana, the author of Kṛtyatattva (<ls>Jīvānandaʼs ed. of Smṛtitattva vol. II, 1895</ls>) quotes a verse from the Devīpurāṇa in connection with the worship of the goddess Manasā to get rid of the fear of snake-bite (<ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Dr. Kaneʼs History of Dharma-śāstra, vol. V. p. 125</ls>). He explains स्नुही as सिजुवृक्षः. The botanic name of the tree is Euphorbia Nerifolia (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>निवहुंग</ns>). It is a plant from the stem of which a sticky substance oozes out.]
